# Diagnostic codes: db area

Codes `DB-<TOPIC>-<NNN>` emitted by `src/core/src/db/` (owner: MODEL,
`openspec/changes/m1-core-viewer/design.md` D2/D3). Conventions and the
renderings are described in [../codes.md](../codes.md).

The table below is generated from `src/core/src/db/codes.cpp`:

```sh
hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=db
```

The unit test `each area's code table matches its document and prefix`
fails when the two disagree.

<!-- BEGIN DIAGNOSTIC CODES (generated by `hefesto-cli --diagnostic-codes=db`) -->
| Code | Default severity | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DB-CELL-001` | error | A cell definition with that name already exists. |
| `DB-CELL-002` | error | The cell definition is still instantiated in another cell and cannot be deleted. |
| `DB-CELL-003` | error | Internal cells cannot be renamed or deleted. |
| `DB-CELL-004` | error | The cell is a vendor (GDS_FILE) cell; renaming it needs -force. |
| `DB-CELL-005` | error | No cell definition with that name exists. |
| `DB-CMD-001` | error | The command needs an edit cell and there is none. |
| `DB-CMD-002` | error | The command needs the box and it is not set. |
| `DB-CMD-003` | error | Unknown or ambiguous layer name. |
| `DB-CMD-004` | error | Invalid command argument value. |
| `DB-CMD-005` | error | No label matches the request. |
| `DB-GEOM-001` | error | Geometry lies outside the usable plane (+-1073741818) and was rejected. |
| `DB-LABEL-001` | error | A label needs non-empty text. |
| `DB-PROP-001` | error | A property value cannot be parsed as the requested type. |
| `DB-REPORT-001` | info | A report or note a command prints while it runs (Magic's TxPrintf text). |
| `DB-REPORT-002` | warning | A warning a command prints while it still runs (Magic's TxError text). |
| `DB-USE-001` | error | Placing the cell would make it contain itself. |
| `DB-USE-002` | error | The instance identifier is already used in the parent. |
| `DB-USE-003` | error | No instance with that identifier exists in the cell. |
| `DB-USE-004` | error | The instance identifier is not valid. |
<!-- END DIAGNOSTIC CODES -->
